editorial:
Imagine being so obsessed with the holidays that you would commit a crime just to save your marriage. That is exactly where you find Ralph, a guy who loves Christmas way too much. He thinks the only way to get his wife back is to bring a real-life piece of his favorite holiday movie into his living room. He decides to kidnap a washed-up child star, thinking it will be a romantic gesture. It starts off as a funny, awkward mess, but things quickly turn sour. You will feel for Ralph at first, but you will soon realize he is much scarier than he looks. It is a wild ride that mixes laughs with some seriously creepy moments.

The acting is top-notch, especially the way Ralph flips from a sweet husband to a total nightmare. The pacing is quick, so you will never feel bored, though some of the horror parts might be too intense for some. If you love movies that make you laugh and scream at the same time, you need to see this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that Ralph has a split personality. The sweet guy and the kidnapper are two different sides of his mind. He tries to force the child star to play a role in a fake Christmas miracle, but it ends in a bloody fight. The twist is that his wife was already planning to leave him because of his madness. He ends up locked in a padded room, still believing he is in a movie.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies with a scary twist.
